title: 壩基帷幕灌漿~Dam-foundation curtain grouting
focus: 裂隙可灌性、有效注入壓力與帷幕驗證~Fracture groutability, effective injection pressure and curtain verification
summary: 本課以壩基帷幕灌漿為入口，深入裂隙可灌性、有效注入壓力與帷幕驗證。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Dam-foundation curtain grouting as its entry point, this course examines fracture groutability, effective injection pressure and curtain verification. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相同壓差下開度由0.1增至0.15 mm，理想流量比(0.15/0.1)³=3.375；牛頓流體層流，不直接代表含顆粒漿液。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設裂隙開度0.2 mm、顆粒d95=0.04 mm，開度粒徑比5；不將此數字當通用可灌門檻，也不推定現地可達距離。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume aperture rises from 0.1 to 0.15 mm at equal pressure gradient. Ideal flow ratio is 3.375 for laminar Newtonian flow, not directly for particle-bearing grout. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fracture aperture 0.2 mm and particle d95=0.04 mm, giving aperture-to-particle ratio five. This is not a universal groutability limit or a prediction of field reach. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
history: 基礎帷幕灌漿把裂隙地質、漿液流變和水力驗證連在一起，耗漿量只是過程資料，真正的工程判斷還要追蹤空間連續與剩餘通水路徑。墾務局重力壩設計專書提供岩基處理與結構整合背景。 土石壩設計標準的基礎灌漿章節更新，官方目錄列明版本。 工兵團灌漿技術手冊出版，整理材料、處理與驗證背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~Foundation curtain grouting connects fracture geology, grout rheology and hydraulic verification. Consumption is process evidence; engineering interpretation must also track spatial continuity and remaining conductive paths. Reclamation gravity-dam guidance provides context for foundation treatment and structural integration. The foundation-grouting chapter of embankment standards is updated, as documented by the official index. USACE publishes Grouting Technology, organizing material, treatment and verification context. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 裂隙開度與流量~Fracture aperture and flow
units.title: 裂隙開度與流量~Fracture aperture and flow
units.mechanism: 薄裂隙的層流流量對水力開度高度敏感，微小張開可造成大流量變化。平行板立方律只是理想模型，粗糙、接觸點與通道化會改變實際通水性。 假設相同壓差下開度由0.1增至0.15 mm，理想流量比(0.15/0.1)³=3.375；牛頓流體層流，不直接代表含顆粒漿液。 把水力開度當作幾何平均寬度會錯估可灌性，壓力上升也可能改變裂隙本身。若只用一次流量反算唯一開度，會掩蓋多通道等效結果的不唯一性。~Laminar flow through a thin fracture is highly sensitive to hydraulic aperture. The parallel-plate cubic law is idealized; roughness, contacts and channeling change actual conductivity and can dominate the measured response. Assume aperture rises from 0.1 to 0.15 mm at equal pressure gradient. Ideal flow ratio is 3.375 for laminar Newtonian flow, not directly for particle-bearing grout. Hydraulic aperture is not geometric mean width, and pressure can change the fracture itself. Inferring one unique aperture from one flow measurement hides the nonuniqueness of several equivalent conducting channels.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相同壓差下開度由0.1增至0.15 mm，理想流量比(0.15/0.1)³=3.375；牛頓流體層流，不直接代表含顆粒漿液。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume aperture rises from 0.1 to 0.15 mm at equal pressure gradient. Ideal flow ratio is 3.375 for laminar Newtonian flow, not directly for particle-bearing grout.
units.verify: 以不同水頭測試流量線性並核對升降壓遲滯，將水試與漿試結果分開；對照孔壁裂隙和示蹤連通資料，確認流量變化不是封塞漏流或裂隙被壓開。~Test flow linearity at several heads and compare loading-unloading hysteresis, separating water and grout tests. Check mapped fractures and tracer connections and rule out packer leakage or pressure-induced opening before interpreting aperture changes.
units.failure: 把水力開度當作幾何平均寬度會錯估可灌性，壓力上升也可能改變裂隙本身。若只用一次流量反算唯一開度，會掩蓋多通道等效結果的不唯一性。~Hydraulic aperture is not geometric mean width, and pressure can change the fracture itself. Inferring one unique aperture from one flow measurement hides the nonuniqueness of several equivalent conducting channels.
units.misconception: 水試反算的水力開度就是所有裂隙的實際幾何寬度。~Water-test hydraulic aperture equals the actual geometric width of every fracture.
units.practice: 以裂隙開度與流量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以不同水頭測試流量線性並核對升降壓遲滯，將水試與漿試結果分開；對照孔壁裂隙和示蹤連通資料，確認流量變化不是封塞漏流或裂隙被壓開。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for fracture aperture and flow, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Test flow linearity at several heads and compare loading-unloading hysteresis, separating water and grout tests. Check mapped fractures and tracer connections and rule out packer leakage or pressure-induced opening before interpreting aperture changes.

units.anchor: 顆粒尺寸與可灌性~Particle size and groutability
units.title: 顆粒尺寸與可灌性~Particle size and groutability
units.mechanism: 水能通過的裂隙未必能讓水泥顆粒通過，顆粒架橋與濾餅會限制滲入。粒徑與開度比只能做篩選，還需考慮聚集、形狀和流變。 假設裂隙開度0.2 mm、顆粒d95=0.04 mm，開度粒徑比5；不將此數字當通用可灌門檻，也不推定現地可達距離。 細度證書不能代表混合後沒有團聚，孔口濾堵可能讓壓力上升卻沒有深部填充。若把高注入壓力當成帷幕密實證據，便可能掩蓋入口附近的局部封堵。~A water-conducting fracture may exclude cement grains. Bridging and filter-cake formation limit penetration, while particle-to-aperture ratio is only screening evidence because agglomeration, shape and rheology also matter. Assume fracture aperture 0.2 mm and particle d95=0.04 mm, giving aperture-to-particle ratio five. This is not a universal groutability limit or a prediction of field reach. A fineness certificate does not exclude agglomeration after mixing. Entrance filtration can raise pressure without deep filling, so high injection pressure alone can conceal a locally blocked entrance rather than a continuous curtain.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設裂隙開度0.2 mm、顆粒d95=0.04 mm，開度粒徑比5；不將此數字當通用可灌門檻，也不推定現地可達距離。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fracture aperture 0.2 mm and particle d95=0.04 mm, giving aperture-to-particle ratio five. This is not a universal groutability limit or a prediction of field reach.
units.verify: 核對實際混合漿液的粒徑與聚集狀態，用代表性裂隙試驗比較進出漿濃度；觀察壓力升高是否伴隨流量降低和濾餅形成，再與水試的通水性分別判讀。檢查回漿是否富含細料。~Check particle size and agglomeration in the mixed grout and compare inlet and outlet concentration in representative fracture tests. Observe pressure rise with declining flow and cake formation, keeping interpretation separate from water conductivity. Check whether returned grout is enriched in fines.
units.failure: 細度證書不能代表混合後沒有團聚，孔口濾堵可能讓壓力上升卻沒有深部填充。若把高注入壓力當成帷幕密實證據，便可能掩蓋入口附近的局部封堵。~A fineness certificate does not exclude agglomeration after mixing. Entrance filtration can raise pressure without deep filling, so high injection pressure alone can conceal a locally blocked entrance rather than a continuous curtain.
units.misconception: 只要岩體能透水，同一裂隙就必定能讓任何水泥漿通過。~Any water-conducting fracture necessarily admits every cement grout mixture.
units.practice: 以顆粒尺寸與可灌性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對實際混合漿液的粒徑與聚集狀態，用代表性裂隙試驗比較進出漿濃度；觀察壓力升高是否伴隨流量降低和濾餅形成，再與水試的通水性分別判讀。檢查回漿是否富含細料。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for particle size and groutability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check particle size and agglomeration in the mixed grout and compare inlet and outlet concentration in representative fracture tests. Observe pressure rise with declining flow and cake formation, keeping interpretation separate from water conductivity. Check whether returned grout is enriched in fines.

units.anchor: 降伏應力與滲入距離~Yield stress and penetration length
units.title: 降伏應力與滲入距離~Yield stress and penetration length
units.mechanism: 含顆粒漿液常有降伏應力，壓力梯度不足時不會像水一樣持續流動。平行裂隙中的門檻量級可解釋為何低黏度仍可能停止，但實際材料也有時變性。 假設Bingham漿降伏應力5 Pa、裂隙開度0.5 mm、長10 m，最低壓差尺度2τyL/b=200 kPa；理想平行板，非現地注入設定。 等待時間改變漿液結構，實際降伏值可能不同於初拌值；裂隙分叉和漏失也使壓力分配改變。只用泵表壓除距離，不能得到真正前緣壓力梯度。~Particle-bearing grout often has yield stress and will not flow like water below a sufficient pressure gradient. An ideal fracture threshold explains arrested penetration despite low plastic viscosity, with real materials also changing over time. Assume Bingham yield stress 5 Pa, aperture 0.5 mm and length 10 m. Threshold scale 2τyL/b=200 kPa, for ideal parallel plates and not a field injection setting. Waiting changes grout structure and yield stress, while branching and losses redistribute pressure. Pump gauge pressure divided by distance does not establish the actual gradient at the advancing front within the fracture network.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設Bingham漿降伏應力5 Pa、裂隙開度0.5 mm、長10 m，最低壓差尺度2τyL/b=200 kPa；理想平行板，非現地注入設定。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume Bingham yield stress 5 Pa, aperture 0.5 mm and length 10 m. Threshold scale 2τyL/b=200 kPa, for ideal parallel plates and not a field injection setting.
units.verify: 以流變儀量測同齡期與溫度的降伏和塑性黏度，檢查剪切歷史影響；用裂隙模型比對停止前緣，並將材料凝結、濾堵與降伏造成的停流分開辨認。比較靜置後再剪切的反應。~Measure yield stress and plastic viscosity at matched age and temperature, checking shear history. Compare stopped fronts in fracture models and distinguish arrest caused by setting, filtration and yield behavior rather than assigning one cause automatically. Compare response after rest and renewed shearing.
units.failure: 等待時間改變漿液結構，實際降伏值可能不同於初拌值；裂隙分叉和漏失也使壓力分配改變。只用泵表壓除距離，不能得到真正前緣壓力梯度。~Waiting changes grout structure and yield stress, while branching and losses redistribute pressure. Pump gauge pressure divided by distance does not establish the actual gradient at the advancing front within the fracture network.
units.misconception: 漿液塑性黏度低就代表不需要壓力梯度也能無限滲入。~Low plastic viscosity means grout can penetrate indefinitely without a pressure gradient.
units.practice: 以降伏應力與滲入距離編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以流變儀量測同齡期與溫度的降伏和塑性黏度，檢查剪切歷史影響；用裂隙模型比對停止前緣，並將材料凝結、濾堵與降伏造成的停流分開辨認。比較靜置後再剪切的反應。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for yield stress and penetration length, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure yield stress and plastic viscosity at matched age and temperature, checking shear history. Compare stopped fronts in fracture models and distinguish arrest caused by setting, filtration and yield behavior rather than assigning one cause automatically. Compare response after rest and renewed shearing.

units.anchor: 孔段壓力與水頭修正~Stage pressure and head correction
units.title: 孔段壓力與水頭修正~Stage pressure and head correction
units.mechanism: 泵端壓力經過管路損失與高程差後才成為孔段壓力，再扣地下水壓得到驅動差。把表壓直接當岩體有效注入壓，會混淆量測位置與參考基準。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設表壓500 kPa、下行漿柱20 m且密度1500 kg/m³、管損50 kPa、地下水壓200 kPa，有效差544.3 kPa；靜態高程修正示例。 管損隨流量改變，停泵讀值不能直接代表注入時孔段壓力。高程方向若用錯符號會產生巨大偏差，還可能把地下水自然壓力誤算為注入效果。~Pump pressure changes through line loss and elevation before reaching the test stage. Subtracting groundwater pressure gives the driving difference, so gauge readings cannot directly represent effective injection pressure in the rock. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume gauge pressure 500 kPa, twenty-metre descending grout column at 1500 kg/m³, line loss 50 kPa and groundwater pressure 200 kPa. Effective difference is 544.3 kPa, a head-correction example. Line losses vary with flow, so stopped-pump readings do not represent flowing stage pressure. A wrong elevation sign creates large error and can confuse natural groundwater pressure with injection-driven response.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設表壓500 kPa、下行漿柱20 m且密度1500 kg/m³、管損50 kPa、地下水壓200 kPa，有效差544.3 kPa；靜態高程修正示例。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume gauge pressure 500 kPa, twenty-metre descending grout column at 1500 kg/m³, line loss 50 kPa and groundwater pressure 200 kPa. Effective difference is 544.3 kPa, a head-correction example.
units.verify: 記錄壓力計與孔段高程、漿密度及流量，獨立估算管損後對照孔內量測；停流和流動狀態分別核對，確認符號和表壓零點未隨設備移動而混淆。以靜止漿柱作零流量對照。~Record gauge and stage elevations, grout density and flow, comparing corrected estimates with downhole measurement. Check flowing and stopped conditions separately and verify signs and gauge zero after equipment relocation. Use a stationary grout column as a zero-flow comparison.
units.failure: 管損隨流量改變，停泵讀值不能直接代表注入時孔段壓力。高程方向若用錯符號會產生巨大偏差，還可能把地下水自然壓力誤算為注入效果。~Line losses vary with flow, so stopped-pump readings do not represent flowing stage pressure. A wrong elevation sign creates large error and can confuse natural groundwater pressure with injection-driven response.
units.misconception: 泵端表壓可不經高程和地下水修正直接當成孔段有效壓力。~Pump gauge pressure directly equals effective stage pressure without elevation or groundwater correction.
units.practice: 以孔段壓力與水頭修正編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。記錄壓力計與孔段高程、漿密度及流量，獨立估算管損後對照孔內量測；停流和流動狀態分別核對，確認符號和表壓零點未隨設備移動而混淆。以靜止漿柱作零流量對照。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for stage pressure and head correction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record gauge and stage elevations, grout density and flow, comparing corrected estimates with downhole measurement. Check flowing and stopped conditions separately and verify signs and gauge zero after equipment relocation. Use a stationary grout column as a zero-flow comparison.

units.anchor: 岩體抬動與壓力邊界~Rock jacking and pressure boundaries
units.title: 岩體抬動與壓力邊界~Rock jacking and pressure boundaries
units.mechanism: 注入壓力若推開節理會改變岩體結構，吸漿量增加不一定代表成功填充。抬動應與原位應力、覆蓋及孔壓共同判讀，不能由固定深度比例推定全部條件。 假設某面總正應力600 kPa、原孔壓200 kPa，有效壓縮400 kPa；若額外孔壓升300 kPa，剩100 kPa，忽略黏結與三維應力重分配。 高壓造成新通道可能短期增加吸漿量，卻把漿液帶到非目標區。若只追求耗漿量而不查抬動和回流，可能損害既有接觸或鄰近構造。~Injection can open joints and change rock structure, so increased take is not automatically successful filling. Jacking interpretation requires in-situ stress, cover and pore pressure rather than one universal depth rule. Assume joint total normal stress 600 kPa and initial pore pressure 200 kPa, leaving effective compression 400 kPa. Added pressure 300 kPa leaves 100 kPa, excluding bond and three-dimensional redistribution. Pressure-created paths can increase take while diverting grout away from its target. Pursuing consumption without checking movement and returns can damage existing contacts or adjacent structures instead of improving the intended barrier.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某面總正應力600 kPa、原孔壓200 kPa，有效壓縮400 kPa；若額外孔壓升300 kPa，剩100 kPa，忽略黏結與三維應力重分配。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint total normal stress 600 kPa and initial pore pressure 200 kPa, leaving effective compression 400 kPa. Added pressure 300 kPa leaves 100 kPa, excluding bond and three-dimensional redistribution.
units.verify: 同步量測孔壓、表面抬動和鄰孔回應，檢查壓流曲線突變是否伴隨幾何改變；以獨立水準基準排除儀器漂移，將可逆壓縮和不可逆張開分開記錄。記錄遠離孔口的參考點位移。~Measure pore pressure, uplift and neighboring-hole response synchronously and test whether pressure-flow breaks accompany movement. Use an independent leveling reference to exclude drift and distinguish reversible deformation from irreversible opening. Record movement at reference points away from the hole.
units.failure: 高壓造成新通道可能短期增加吸漿量，卻把漿液帶到非目標區。若只追求耗漿量而不查抬動和回流，可能損害既有接觸或鄰近構造。~Pressure-created paths can increase take while diverting grout away from its target. Pursuing consumption without checking movement and returns can damage existing contacts or adjacent structures instead of improving the intended barrier.
units.misconception: 吸漿量突然增加就必定表示帷幕填充效果變得更好。~A sudden increase in grout take necessarily indicates improved curtain filling.
units.practice: 以岩體抬動與壓力邊界編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測孔壓、表面抬動和鄰孔回應，檢查壓流曲線突變是否伴隨幾何改變；以獨立水準基準排除儀器漂移，將可逆壓縮和不可逆張開分開記錄。記錄遠離孔口的參考點位移。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rock jacking and pressure boundaries, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure pore pressure, uplift and neighboring-hole response synchronously and test whether pressure-flow breaks accompany movement. Use an independent leveling reference to exclude drift and distinguish reversible deformation from irreversible opening. Record movement at reference points away from the hole.

units.anchor: 耗漿量與孔隙估算~Grout take and void estimate
units.title: 耗漿量與孔隙估算~Grout take and void estimate
units.mechanism: 耗漿量包含管內存量、回流、漏失和實際填充，不能全當成岩體孔隙。帷幕幾何的等效孔隙估算可做量級比較，但裂隙分布通常高度不均。 假設處理區100×20×3 m、等效可填孔隙率0.01，理想填充60 m³；實際供漿90 m³與其差30 m³須分解來源，非自動灌得更好。 漿液流入大空洞或遠端通道會消耗大量材料而不形成連續帷幕，析水又使硬化體積小於注入體積。總耗漿相符仍不能證明目標裂隙全部被封住。~Grout consumption includes line storage, returns, losses and actual filling. A geometric equivalent-void estimate compares scales, but fracture distribution is usually uneven and consumption cannot all be assigned to rock voids. Assume treatment zone 100×20×3 m with equivalent fillable void fraction 0.01. Ideal volume is 60 m³; delivery 90 m³ leaves 30 m³ requiring source accounting rather than proving improvement. A cavity or distant channel consumes material without forming a continuous curtain, while bleeding reduces hardened volume. Matching total take therefore does not prove that all targeted flow paths have been sealed.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設處理區100×20×3 m、等效可填孔隙率0.01，理想填充60 m³；實際供漿90 m³與其差30 m³須分解來源，非自動灌得更好。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume treatment zone 100×20×3 m with equivalent fillable void fraction 0.01. Ideal volume is 60 m³; delivery 90 m³ leaves 30 m³ requiring source accounting rather than proving improvement.
units.verify: 建立供漿、回流、設備存量與地表逸出分帳，逐孔段核對體積和固體質量；把耗漿分布與地質裂隙對照，檢查極大值是否由單一通道控制而非平均孔隙增加。比較重量與體積計量的一致性。~Account separately for supply, returns, equipment storage and surface escape, checking volume and solids by stage. Compare takes with mapped fractures and determine whether extreme values reflect one channel rather than uniformly increased voids. Cross-check mass-based and volume-based accounting.
units.failure: 漿液流入大空洞或遠端通道會消耗大量材料而不形成連續帷幕，析水又使硬化體積小於注入體積。總耗漿相符仍不能證明目標裂隙全部被封住。~A cavity or distant channel consumes material without forming a continuous curtain, while bleeding reduces hardened volume. Matching total take therefore does not prove that all targeted flow paths have been sealed.
units.misconception: 供漿總體積就是硬化後留在目標裂隙中的有效填充體積。~Total supplied grout equals the hardened effective volume retained in targeted fractures.
units.practice: 以耗漿量與孔隙估算編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。建立供漿、回流、設備存量與地表逸出分帳，逐孔段核對體積和固體質量；把耗漿分布與地質裂隙對照，檢查極大值是否由單一通道控制而非平均孔隙增加。比較重量與體積計量的一致性。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for grout take and void estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Account separately for supply, returns, equipment storage and surface escape, checking volume and solids by stage. Compare takes with mapped fractures and determine whether extreme values reflect one channel rather than uniformly increased voids. Cross-check mass-based and volume-based accounting.

units.title: 壓水試驗標準化~Water-test normalization
units.mechanism: 孔段長度與試驗壓力不同時，流量需標準化才能初步比較。比例換算假設近似線性流動，裂隙張開或紊流會破壞這個關係。 假設流量10 L/min、孔段5 m、有效試壓0.8 MPa，線性換算到1 MPa為10/5×1/0.8=2.5 L/(min·m)；非直接滲透係數。 同樣標準化數值可能來自不同裂隙幾何和各向異性，不能直接換成唯一k值。封塞旁漏或孔壁損傷也會提高讀數，需用獨立證據區分。~Different stage lengths and test pressures require normalized flow for preliminary comparison. Proportional scaling assumes nearly linear flow, which joint opening and turbulence can invalidate. Assume flow 10 L/min, stage length 5 m and effective pressure 0.8 MPa. Linear normalization to 1 MPa gives 2.5 L/(min·m), not a permeability coefficient directly. Equal normalized values can arise from different fracture geometries and anisotropy and do not determine a unique k. Packer bypass and drilling damage also raise readings and require separate evidence to distinguish.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設流量10 L/min、孔段5 m、有效試壓0.8 MPa，線性換算到1 MPa為10/5×1/0.8=2.5 L/(min·m)；非直接滲透係數。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume flow 10 L/min, stage length 5 m and effective pressure 0.8 MPa. Linear normalization to 1 MPa gives 2.5 L/(min·m), not a permeability coefficient directly.
units.verify: 核對有效壓力、孔段長度與封塞密封，繪升降壓流量曲線測線性；只在相同流況下比較前後結果，並保留原始各級數據，避免標準化掩蓋遲滯或漏流。~Verify effective pressure, stage length and packer seal and plot ascending and descending pressure-flow curves. Compare before and after only under equivalent regimes, retaining raw stages so normalization does not conceal hysteresis or leakage.
units.failure: 同樣標準化數值可能來自不同裂隙幾何和各向異性，不能直接換成唯一k值。封塞旁漏或孔壁損傷也會提高讀數，需用獨立證據區分。~Equal normalized values can arise from different fracture geometries and anisotropy and do not determine a unique k. Packer bypass and drilling damage also raise readings and require separate evidence to distinguish.
units.misconception: 標準化壓水值可不經幾何假設直接視為岩體滲透係數。~Normalized water-test flow directly equals rock permeability without geometric assumptions.
units.practice: 以壓水試驗標準化編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對有效壓力、孔段長度與封塞密封，繪升降壓流量曲線測線性；只在相同流況下比較前後結果，並保留原始各級數據，避免標準化掩蓋遲滯或漏流。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for water-test normalization, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Verify effective pressure, stage length and packer seal and plot ascending and descending pressure-flow curves. Compare before and after only under equivalent regimes, retaining raw stages so normalization does not conceal hysteresis or leakage.

units.anchor: 鑽孔偏斜與帷幕連續~Borehole deviation and curtain continuity
units.title: 鑽孔偏斜與帷幕連續~Borehole deviation and curtain continuity
units.mechanism: 深孔會偏離設計線，孔口間距相符不代表深部間距相符。帷幕連續性依實際孔跡與可達處理範圍判讀，不能只按平面鑽孔圖驗收。 假設孔深60 m、固定偏斜角2°，水平偏移Lsin2°=2.094 m；直線偏孔示例，實際孔跡可能彎曲且方向變化。 兩孔朝相反方向偏移會在深部拉開大缺口，同向偏移則可能讓整排偏離目標。僅看平均偏斜角，會漏掉局部曲折造成的最近或最遠間距。~Deep holes deviate from design lines, so correct collar spacing does not establish spacing at depth. Curtain continuity depends on actual trajectories and treatment reach rather than the plan of drill collars alone. Assume hole length 60 m and constant deviation two degrees. Horizontal offset Lsin2°=2.094 m, a straight-deviation example rather than a curved real trajectory. Opposing deviations open deep gaps, while common-direction deviation shifts the row away from its target. Mean deviation angle misses local curvature controlling the closest and widest spacing between treatment paths.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設孔深60 m、固定偏斜角2°，水平偏移Lsin2°=2.094 m；直線偏孔示例，實際孔跡可能彎曲且方向變化。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume hole length 60 m and constant deviation two degrees. Horizontal offset Lsin2°=2.094 m, a straight-deviation example rather than a curved real trajectory.
units.verify: 用分段測斜重建三維孔跡，將相鄰孔在同高程的距離畫出；對照驗證孔與示蹤連通，檢查最大間隙位置，並保留磁性干擾和定位不確定度。將最大偏距位置納入覆蓋圖。~Reconstruct three-dimensional paths with staged surveys and plot spacing between adjacent holes at equal elevations. Compare verification holes and tracer connectivity, identifying largest gaps while retaining magnetic and positional uncertainties. Include maximum-deviation locations in the coverage map.
units.failure: 兩孔朝相反方向偏移會在深部拉開大缺口，同向偏移則可能讓整排偏離目標。僅看平均偏斜角，會漏掉局部曲折造成的最近或最遠間距。~Opposing deviations open deep gaps, while common-direction deviation shifts the row away from its target. Mean deviation angle misses local curvature controlling the closest and widest spacing between treatment paths.
units.misconception: 孔口間距完全符合設計就能保證深部帷幕一定連續。~Correct collar spacing guarantees a continuous curtain at every depth.
units.practice: 以鑽孔偏斜與帷幕連續編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用分段測斜重建三維孔跡，將相鄰孔在同高程的距離畫出；對照驗證孔與示蹤連通，檢查最大間隙位置，並保留磁性干擾和定位不確定度。將最大偏距位置納入覆蓋圖。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for borehole deviation and curtain continuity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct three-dimensional paths with staged surveys and plot spacing between adjacent holes at equal elevations. Compare verification holes and tracer connectivity, identifying largest gaps while retaining magnetic and positional uncertainties. Include maximum-deviation locations in the coverage map.

units.anchor: 序列孔耗量趨勢~Successive-hole take trends
units.title: 序列孔耗量趨勢~Successive-hole take trends
units.mechanism: 逐次縮小孔距常用來觀察處理後剩餘可灌性，但耗量下降也可能受材料、壓力和孔段條件改變。趨勢必須在可比較條件下解讀，不能單獨作完成證明。 假設可比較孔段的單位耗量由30降至12再到6 kg/m，最後相對初始下降80%；只是趨勢指標，不等同滲透率下降80%。 先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。只追求下降曲線會導致錯誤完工判讀。~Successive spacing reduction can reveal remaining groutability, but declining take also reflects changed mixtures, pressures and stages. Trends require comparable conditions and cannot alone establish completion of a hydraulic barrier. Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m. Final take is eighty percent below initial, a trend indicator rather than an eighty-percent permeability reduction. Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume. Pursuing a falling curve alone can therefore lead to an incorrect completion assessment.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設可比較孔段的單位耗量由30降至12再到6 kg/m，最後相對初始下降80%；只是趨勢指標，不等同滲透率下降80%。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m. Final take is eighty percent below initial, a trend indicator rather than an eighty-percent permeability reduction.
units.verify: 按相同地層、孔段長度和有效壓力分組比較耗量，核對材料濃度與停止條件；用獨立壓水或驗證孔檢查低耗量區仍否存在未被相交的連通裂隙。分開比較不同材料批次的結果。~Group takes by geology, stage length and effective pressure, checking mix concentration and stopping conditions. Use independent water tests or verification holes to determine whether low-take regions retain connected fractures not intersected by treatment. Compare different mixture batches separately.
units.failure: 先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。只追求下降曲線會導致錯誤完工判讀。~Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume. Pursuing a falling curve alone can therefore lead to an incorrect completion assessment.
units.misconception: 後續孔耗漿量下降百分之八十就代表滲透率必定下降八成。~An eighty-percent decline in later-hole take guarantees an eighty-percent permeability reduction.
units.practice: 以序列孔耗量趨勢編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按相同地層、孔段長度和有效壓力分組比較耗量，核對材料濃度與停止條件；用獨立壓水或驗證孔檢查低耗量區仍否存在未被相交的連通裂隙。分開比較不同材料批次的結果。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for successive-hole take trends, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Group takes by geology, stage length and effective pressure, checking mix concentration and stopping conditions. Use independent water tests or verification holes to determine whether low-take regions retain connected fractures not intersected by treatment. Compare different mixture batches separately.

units.anchor: 獨立驗證與統計分布~Independent verification and distributions
units.title: 獨立驗證與統計分布~Independent verification and distributions
units.mechanism: 帷幕驗證應以水力性能與空間覆蓋為主，不能只重用施工過程數據。裂隙岩體常有偏態分布，平均值會被少數高透水段支配，需保留位置。 假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。平均(1+1+2+3+20)/5=5.4 L/(min·m)，中位2 L/(min·m)；非直接滲透係數，異常高值不能因中位低而刪除。 低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。缺乏位置與原始曲線時，統計不能分辨真正缺口和儀器假象。~Curtain verification prioritizes hydraulic performance and coverage rather than reusing process records. Fractured rock commonly has skewed results, so a few conductive stages dominate means and locations must remain visible. Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m). Mean (1+1+2+3+20)/5 is 5.4 L/(min·m) and median is 2 L/(min·m). These are not direct permeability coefficients; the high value cannot be discarded because the median is low. A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage. Without location and raw curves, statistics cannot distinguish a real gap from an instrumentation artifact.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。平均(1+1+2+3+20)/5=5.4 L/(min·m)，中位2 L/(min·m)；非直接滲透係數，異常高值不能因中位低而刪除。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m). Mean (1+1+2+3+20)/5 is 5.4 L/(min·m) and median is 2 L/(min·m). These are not direct permeability coefficients; the high value cannot be discarded because the median is low.
units.verify: 將驗證孔獨立於施工孔選址，繪出每孔段結果與不確定度；同時報平均、中位和高值位置，對高值回查地質連通及測試完整性，避免只用摘要統計宣布合格。~Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty. Report mean, median and high-value locations, investigating geology and test integrity at extremes instead of declaring success from summary statistics alone.
units.failure: 低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。缺乏位置與原始曲線時，統計不能分辨真正缺口和儀器假象。~A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage. Without location and raw curves, statistics cannot distinguish a real gap from an instrumentation artifact.
units.misconception: 驗證結果中位數很低就能忽略少數高透水孔段。~A low verification median allows highly permeable individual stages to be ignored.
units.practice: 以獨立驗證與統計分布編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將驗證孔獨立於施工孔選址，繪出每孔段結果與不確定度；同時報平均、中位和高值位置，對高值回查地質連通及測試完整性，避免只用摘要統計宣布合格。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for independent verification and distributions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty. Report mean, median and high-value locations, investigating geology and test integrity at extremes instead of declaring success from summary statistics alone.

facts: 教學裂隙開度0.1增至0.15 mm，理想流量比3.375。~Teaching aperture increase from 0.1 to 0.15 mm gives ideal flow ratio 3.375.
教學開度與d95粒徑比5，非通用可灌門檻。~Teaching aperture-to-d95 ratio is five, not a universal groutability threshold.
教學Bingham裂隙流動壓差尺度200 kPa，非注入設定。~Teaching Bingham fracture threshold scale is 200 kPa, not an injection setting.
教學高程及水壓修正後有效注入差544.3 kPa。~Teaching elevation and groundwater corrections give effective pressure difference 544.3 kPa.
教學60 m孔長固定偏斜2°造成2.094 m偏移。~Teaching sixty-metre hole deviating two degrees has offset 2.094 m.

教學五孔段流量按1 MPa線性標準化後，平均5.4 L/(min·m)、中位2 L/(min·m)，保留極端值位置；非直接滲透係數。~Five teaching stage flows, linearly normalized to 1 MPa, have mean 5.4 L/(min·m) and median 2 L/(min·m). Retain extreme-value locations; these are not direct permeability coefficients.
